description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BurgerSeller"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuQuestion" name="Menu choice question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuAnswer" name="Menu choice answer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideAnswer" name="Side choice answer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Burger preparation status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion" name="Menu choice question" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuAnswer" name="Menu choice answer" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_SelectMenu" messageRef="Message_MenuAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_SideQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideAnswer" name="Side choice answer" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_SelectSide" messageRef="Message_SideAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenu" name="Ask whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectMenu" name="Select menu or just burger"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" name="Prepare menu items in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSide" name="Ask whether the customer wants fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SideQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectSide" name="Select fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the fries order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin" name="Menu items ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BurgerPrep" name="Burger preparation starts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
        <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BurgerPrep" name="Burger prepared"/>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_StatusUpdates" name="Send enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Status">
            <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
          </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusSent" name="Status update sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_End" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusSent"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerPrep_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_BurgerPrep" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerPrep_End" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="EndEvent_BurgerPrep"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToQuestion" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_AskMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionToSelection" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Task_SelectMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectionToMenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectMenu" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">menuSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_BurgerOnly" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">menuSelected = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_AskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSide"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSide_Select" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Task_SelectSide"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SideGateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectSide" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoice_Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">friesSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoice_Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wedgesSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries_SideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges_SideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMerge_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoin_BurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerMerge_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="SubProcess_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Deliver" sourceRef="SubProcess_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_End" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
